name: Omar Banerjee
headline: Security Engineer
summary: Security engineer with a background in software development, application security, and automation across product teams. Experienced in building reliable systems, strengthening access controls, and improving testing and delivery workflows. Known for practical risk reduction, clear collaboration, and disciplined engineering execution.

roles.title: Junior Software Engineer
bullets: Built backend components in C++ and Go on Azure, delivering new features for internal tooling with fewer manual handoffs.
Improved service reliability by tracing defects in C and Go, which cut recurring incident volume by 18%.
Supported releases in Azure by coordinating code changes and validating fixes across shared components.

roles.title: Security Engineer
bullets: Hardened core services in C and Go by reviewing source changes and closing security gaps before release.
Used Git to manage remediation branches and keep fixes aligned across three active product lines.
Investigated suspicious behavior in network-facing code and reduced repeat findings by 22% through targeted controls.

roles.title: Application Security Engineer
bullets: Performed Penetration testing against C and C++ services to uncover weaknesses before customer rollout.
Reviewed risky code paths in C and C++ with Git-based change control, helping the team prioritize the highest-impact fixes.
Documented findings and retested remediations, which reduced reopened issues by 30%.

roles.title: Senior Security Engineer
bullets: Led Agile security work across CI/CD pipelines, coordinating reviews for Go and Rust services in a fast-moving release cycle.
Designed Threat modeling sessions for new features and paired them with Cryptography guidance to lower design risk early.
Built Test automation with Cucumber, Cypress and pytest, increasing coverage for critical paths by 40%.
Strengthened IAM and Linux hardening for production environments while using Docker and GitHub Actions to keep deployments repeatable.
Ran Performance testing and Postman checks for APIs, then tuned bottlenecks that improved median response time by 25%.
